about: X-Caliber (::/Apps/X-Caliber) replayed deterministically in the original TempleOS V5.03 (reference VM). INSTRUMENTED DRIVER tools/reference-vm/harness/XCaliberPhysics.HC (its header lists every difference from the real game: harness clock for tS, fixed window size, no real-time timeout, fixed ODE tolerance 1e-6, scripted input: thrust frames 10-40, fire frame 30, left missile frame 60). The CD's X-Caliber files are included unmodified. States at frames 0, 30, 60, 90, 120 (30 Hz): every mass's x, y, DxDt, DyDt (raw F64 bits) in the ODE's mass order, ships, missiles; mass_hash = FNV-1a 64 over x,y,DxDt,DyDt bytes of all masses in order; state_hash adds score and ship count. Mode templeos_rand uses TempleOS's RandU16/Rand after Seed(12345); mode harness_lcg replaces them in the game's code by the driver's own copy of the same LCG (so engines with a different Rand can be compared).
floating_point_note: TempleOS's compiler evaluates F64 expressions on the x87 FPU (80-bit registers, precision control left at the FNINIT default: 64-bit mantissa); values are rounded to IEEE double only when stored. QEMU TCG emulates the x87 in software (floatx80).
